quantities.note: The client's own Schedule of Works states item 6.01 as 'm2' with quantity 0 - 'Supply and fit new external windows and doors AS SHOWN ON DRAWING; tenderer to approach specialist suppliers for quotes'. MTCBC issued NO quantity, so the Brocks Hill test (compare our area against the client's stated quantity) cannot be run on this job - there is nothing to compare against. Quantity therefore rests entirely on window schedule 2376-09, and SOW 0.08 puts that risk on the tenderer: 'Contractor is to satisfy themselves of all submitted quantities.'

u_value.required: CONFLICT INSIDE THE TENDER PACK. Window schedule 2376-09 states 1.4 W/m2K against each window type (33 notes). EDG02 Energy and Carbon Design Guidelines - Building Fabric, issued in the same 08/07 pack, sets minimum performance for REFURBISHMENT at 1.3 W/m2K windows (double glazed), 1.2 W/m2K external doors, and glazing g-value 0.4-0.3. Fenster's proposal promises 1.4 W/m2K, which meets the schedule and misses both EDG02 figures. RFI-1 raised.
u_value.note: Basis is per element because 2376-09 states the figure against each window type individually, not as a package average. NOTE (SM5 Wexham rule): the only U-value CALCULATION in the job folder is Aplus K_QP70172 of 22/07 - average Uw 1.37 W/m2K over 210.2 m2 - and that is an AVERAGE, computed for TECHNAL frames we did not buy. It is not evidence for what we sold.
